pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — elevated 502/5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (region: us-west-2). Incident: INC-1779993333.

sri (oncall): I’m on it. what’s the initial scope? seeing amplification?

marta (eng-runtime): Getting segfaults from quant attention kernel on a subset of modelrunner nodes after a scale-up. Repro rate ~12% of requests to redwood-embed-1-quant. Logs show kernel SIGSEGV during KV cache replay.

devon (eng-sre): Any recent rollout? autoscaler activity?

marta (eng-runtime): We had a small quant-kernel perf rollout 15m ago (v12 -> v13) to dedicated pools. Autoscaler added nodes and some got v13 kernels.

lydia (cs): Several customers reported increased 502s and timeouts in support tickets. Can we get ETA?

marta (eng-runtime): Collecting a stack trace now. snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T21:09:11Z] modelrunner[pid=2432]: SIGSEGV at kv_cache.c:482
Backtrace:
  0x7f8a2a1a kv_cache_replay
  0x7f8a2b3c attention_quant_exec
  0x55b8d3 model_forward
```

sri (oncall): Ok mitigation options: 1) reroute traffic away from redwood-embed-1-quant to fallback variant (fp16) 2) scale down nodes with v13 3) hot-revert kernel rollout. Which is fastest?

devon (eng-sre): Reroute is quickest and lowest-risk. We can flip routing for embeddings to `redwood-embed-1-fallback` and keep telemetry.

marta (eng-runtime): Agree. Initiating routing change now. Command: `rtectl promote --service=embeddings --from=redwood-embed-1-quant --to=redwood-embed-1-fp16 --percent=100`

deploy-bot: Route change request queued: RTX-4439. Applying...

(30s)

deploy-bot: Route change complete — traffic to redwood-embed-1-fp16 (100%). Health checks passed.

marta (eng-runtime): Metrics: 502 rate on embeddings dropped from 7.8% -> 0.6% after the reroute. Latency stable.

lydia (cs): Notifying impacted customers: message drafted and will be sent with mitigation details and ETA for root cause.

sri (oncall): Great. Can runtime team still reproduce locally?

marta (eng-runtime): We can reproduce with quant kernel v13 + certain kv cache patterns on a local repro harness. Repro is intermittent but consistent enough. We'll rollback the rollout in the dedicated pool and block v13 until patch.

devon (eng-sre): Initiating rollback command for kernel rollout on fleet: `opsctl rollout rollback --tag=quant-kernel-v13 --scope=dedicated-pools`

deploy-bot: Rollback started (RB-7721). Progress: 0/6 nodes -> 3/6 -> 6/6.

(4m)
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. All dedicated nodes back to v12.

marta (eng-runtime): Confirming logs: no more SIGSEGVs on those nodes for last 3m. We'll keep reroute in place until a patched kernel is validated.

sri (oncall): Customer impact: support queue notes 18 tickets in last hour, mostly transient 502s. Lydia, can you add a note to status page that embeddings in us-west-2 had elevated 5xx but traffic rerouted, customers on fallback saw normal performance?

lydia (cs): Will publish short status update now.

marta (eng-runtime): Postmortem action items: 1) block v13 rollout until kernel fix, 2) add canary health gating that catches KV-replay SIGSEGVs, 3) add a metric for quant-kernel crash ratio, 4) add automatic traffic failover for embeddings per pool.

sri (oncall): also add runbook step: if we see segfault pattern `kv_cache.c:482` reroute to fallback and start rollback; page eng-runtime.

devon (eng-sre): For follow-up: identify why autoscaler put v13 on a subset of nodes (mismatch in rollout tags). Might need stronger rollout affinity.

marta (eng-runtime): Working on a patch to handle the particular cache alignment bug; will validate on canary and then propose a controlled rollout.

pagerbot: Incident INC-1779993333 marked: MITIGATED — traffic rerouted and faulty kernel rolled back. Postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC.

sri (oncall): Thanks team. Closing the live incident channel. Follow-ups tracked in INC-1779993333-PR (postmortem). :white_check_mark:
